# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server across a map end and a round restart.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm, joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp, role mapchange
# dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults but for the
# limit cvars the recipe sets. mapchange, one probe:
#   tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_gametype dm +set scr_dm_timelimit 1 \
#     +set sv_mapRotation "gametype dm map mp_carentan map mp_brecourt"
#   --net-probe <ip:port> --probe-team allies --save-mapchange --probe-secs 150
# roundrestart, two probes on opposite teams, the target started first:
#   tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_gametype sd +set scr_sd_roundlength 1 \
#     +set scr_friendlyfire 1
#   --probe-team axis --probe-target --save-roundrestart --probe-secs 200
#   --probe-team allies --save-roundrestart --probe-secs 160
# One !gamestate per gamestate, one !cmd per serverCommand with its reliable
# sequence, one !oob per connectionless packet, and one !trace per snapshot
# whose watched fields moved plus one a second so a settled stretch still
# carries a timeline. ms is since the capture started; serverTime is the
# server's own clock. ammoclip is the non-zero entries, as index:value.
